title: Service reliability and observability
description: Checks for teams that set service reliability targets and use OpenTelemetry to measure service behavior.

sources.title: Google SRE Workbook, Example Error Budget Policy
Google SRE Workbook, Alerting on SLOs

rules.instruction: For a critical user journey, document the service level indicator (SLI), the target (SLO), the measurement window and who owns the result.
rules.verification: Recalculate the SLI from a representative sample, including failures and any exclusions. Have the service owner confirm the target and window.

rules.instruction: Define what the team does as the service consumes its error budget, and link alert rules to the runbook and on-call owner.
rules.verification: Replay healthy, degraded and missing-data samples in a test environment. Check the alert outcomes and routing against the runbook.

rules.instruction: For instruments used in service dashboards or alerts, apply the project's selected OpenTelemetry semantic conventions. Record the signal, units and attributes used by each consumer.
rules.verification: Send a synthetic request through the configured telemetry pipeline, using OTLP if selected. Compare the resulting instruments and attributes with dashboard and alert queries.

rules.instruction: Collect only the attributes required for operations. Keep credentials out of telemetry and include personal data only for approved fields and purposes.
rules.verification: Use a synthetic request with sensitive-looking inputs and inspect the exported sample. Confirm that the pipeline omits or redacts the fields required by policy.
